scientific_integrity: Oscillatory radial Berezin attenuation already appears in Looi (2026); the proposed novelty is the sharp nonradial hyponormal phase transition and extreme attenuation within its hyponormal regime.
scientific_limitations: Standard unweighted one-variable Bergman A2 only; compares boundary Berezin modulus, not global Berezin number; independent audit and publication priority not established.
title: Sharp hyponormal phase transition and boundary Berezin attenuation for oscillatory Bergman Toeplitz shifts
